concept: ElastiCache Redis: HA cache with Multi-AZ and replicas
tests: Choosing an in-memory cache with automatic failover and persistence (leaderboard).
expected: ElastiCache for Redis with replicas and Multi-AZ auto failover, persistence (AOF/snapshots), sorted sets for the leaderboard. Triggers: "highly available", "automatic failover", "persistence", "leaderboard".
why_not: Memcached — no replication or failover; DAX is only for DynamoDB; the RDS query cache is not a standalone cache service.
